about_the_game:
Explore Planet Gaiganthra

Gaiganthra, a massive planet, is the first planet humans managed to successfully land on, thanks to the help of alien allies (more about them in-game). Earth’s Defense Forces established small bases there, and all was going well… until suddenly, we lost all contact.

A few crews from the special forces unit known as IPS-13 (Inter-planetary squad) were sent to investigate, but we lost contact with them shortly after landing.. Now, Captain Hari Singh [more unlockable Captains]  of IPS-13 along with his chosen crew members leads the final mission, carrying the special key to VOD’s bunker. You are the last hope to uncover what happened on Gaiganthra as the crew boards the final ship capable of interplanetary travel.

Your survival is the top priority. You have full authorization to engage any suspicious or hostile entities with maximum force — “No questions asked.” Along the way, you may rescue survivors, negotiate with factions, or destroy anything that poses a danger. No mercy.

Built by human and alien researchers, the VOD(Vehicle Of Destruction) is a colossal armored war machine loaded with devastating weapons. As an IPS-13 captain, you’ll command the VOD, explore hostile territory, and neutralize any threats that stand in your way.

  • The VOD comes equipped with vital systems like engines, shield, weapons, oxygen(O2), and more. You will be manually distributing the power to these systems, depending on your strategy and available power.

  • You will also need to assign crew members to repair, operate, and defend these systems.

  • During combat, enemy weapons can sometimes pierce your armor thus injuring crew and damaging the systems. You will need to send your crew to fix hull breaches, put out fires, and fight of intruders who board your vehicle.

As a roguelike game, every run presents fresh paths, unpredictable encounters, and hidden events. Plus, randomized shop items give you the opportunity to try different combos of powerful weapons, systems, and crews, allowing for unique playstyles each time.

  • Discover scrapyards, shops, and outposts where you can upgrade your VOD, buy or sell weapons, and recruit new crew members from different factions on that planet.

  • Unlock different IPS-13 captains each with there own strengths and abilities.

  • Unlock exciting new VODs some of which were kept top secrets and never revealed to anyone and others which are of alien factions. Each with it's own unique legacy, design, abilities, and crew.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core processor, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core processor, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU, 2 GB VRAM / GTX 750ti or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Take command of the massive VOD(Vehicle of Destruction) and journey across planet Gaiganthra with your IPS(Inter-Planetary Squad)-13 crew to uncover the mystery of humans there. Be prepared for the worse and ready to fight. Upgrade your VOD, hire new crew factions, to be the ultimate War Machine.

English*, German, Japanese
